messages:
hana: Quick question from research: users expect to see suppressed channels in the notify summary. Hiding them felt like a bug. Proposing we add a tiny legend in the compact row: "Notify summary: 2 active, 1 suppressed" and show suppressed chips visually.
omar: I like the legend. Keeps counts explicit without expanding the row. For chips, use a small bell-off icon + muted label. Make icon aria-hidden and add SR-only text for reason/time.
tess: UX microcopy: instead of 'suppressed' maybe 'silenced until 3:00 PM' reads clearer for non-technical folks. What do you think?
aha: Good point. 'Silenced' is friendlier. Proposal: legend reads '2 active, 1 silenced' and the chip tooltip says 'Silenced until 15:00 for maintenance'.
a11y-bot: Accessibility: ensure legend updates are announced to screen readers. Wrap the legend in an aria-live="polite" region. Provide full annunciation text like 'Notify summary: 2 active, 1 silenced until 15:00'.
omar: Dev note: clicking the silenced chip should open the suppression details. Keep quick-toggle separate so clicks don't overlap. I'll add event.stopPropagation on the toggle.
infra: Also include an inline 'why' link in expanded preview that points to a short doc explaining suppression semantics. PM asked for less surprise when alerts are silenced.
tess: Mobile: make legend tappable to open the full list. Also ensure the silenced icon hit target >= 44px.
aha: Copy tweak for empty state: change 'No channels selected' -> 'No channels will be notified. Add channels to receive alerts.' Small nudge to action.
a11y-bot: Reminder: when truncating channel names visually, keep full name + state in aria-label. Example: 'Slack channel #very-long-name, notifications off, silenced until 15:00'.
hana: Agreed. I'll update the mock with the legend and chip pattern and run a 5-min a11y pass after the deploy. Thanks all.
